name: Cherryblossom
source:
Ouse Satsuki, a second year student of Sakurazono Gakuen receives one day on his cell phone a message from a stranger. The address of the sender is from a student on campus, but in the school there isn't any student with that name. Is the sender someone from the student council, or is it someone else?

[From [url=http://www.yaoiotaku.com/cherry-blossom-game.html]YaoiOtaku[/url]]

You have to schedule your activities in order to increase your character's various parameters, with new events appearing and the affection felt by others towards you increasing as you grow stronger. The game uses the "reverse character coupling system," whereby stats changes not only occur on the side of the player character, but also on the NPCs'.

[From [url=http://www.ebay.com/ctg/Cherry-Blossom-Sega-Dreamcast-2004-/56253965]eBay[/url]]
translation:
樱园学园二年级学生逢濑五月，一天在手机上收到陌生人发来的短信。发件地址显示对方是校内学生，可学校里根本没有这个名字的人。发件人究竟是学生会成员，还是另有其人？

[摘自[url=http://www.yaoiotaku.com/cherry-blossom-game.html]YaoiOtaku[/url]]

玩家需要安排活动，提高角色的各项能力参数。随着角色不断成长，新的事件将陆续出现，其他人对你的好感也会提升。游戏采用“反向角色配对系统”，能力数值的变化不仅发生在玩家角色身上，也会影响非玩家角色。

[摘自[url=http://www.ebay.com/ctg/Cherry-Blossom-Sega-Dreamcast-2004-/56253965]eBay[/url]]
